name: Platonic Love
source:
A lonely girl waits by a bus stop, contemplating the girl she loves and the pain of her platonic feelings. To her surprise, the lonely girl's crush shows up at the bus stop too, waiting for her ride home. What would usually be a normal conversation between two schoolgirls unfolds into a blooming unveiling of emotion, passion and love.
